mostWorthwhile.text: Showing water conservation followed by replacement was most worthwhile: the two constructions distinguish reclaiming existing water from replenishing what was lost and show the feedback response.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial construction order was mildly confusing: nerve terminals and pituitary capillaries looked compatible, but the sensing cells had to be connected first.

surprise.text: The failed first pairing automatically assembled the sensing circuit instead; the later result clarified how a nerve signal becomes a blood-borne hormone signal.

arbitrary.text: Requiring the sensing circuit before attaching the capillary bed felt somewhat arbitrary from the initial picture descriptions, although the compatibility feedback made the next step clear.

continue.text: I would continue: connecting familiar systems through a concrete feedback loop was interesting, and the planned illustrations made the distinction between conservation and replacement useful.
